title: Wave4ExecutionState
description: Execution state ledger for the Wave 4 parallel refactor orchestration harness. This is the single source of truth for the supervisor agent.

planRef.description: Path to the plan document that this execution state derives from.

startedAt.description: ISO 8601 datetime when the supervisor began execution.

lastUpdatedAt.description: ISO 8601 datetime of the last state mutation.

supervisorSessionId.description: Task ID of the supervisor agent session, enabling resumption after interruption.

units.description: Map of unitId → UnitState for all 10 Wave 4 units (U00–U09).

fileLocks.description: Map of repo-relative file path → owning unitId. Empty object means no locks held.

conflictMatrix.description: Shared file conflict matrix transcribed from the plan document.

validationLog.description: Ordered log of all validation checks run during execution.

blockers.description: List of active blockers that prevent units from proceeding.

UnitState.description: State of a single execution unit.

prId.description: PR identifier from the strategy document, e.g. P3-02.

status.description: Current execution status. See state transition diagram in the supervisor agent.

upstreamUnits.description: Unit IDs that must complete before this unit can start.

upstreamGates.description: External gates (e.g. PR merges, policy decisions) that must be satisfied.

satisfied.description: Whether all upstream dependencies and gates are currently satisfied.

fileOwnership.description: Files this unit owns for modification, creation, testing, and handoff.

modify.description: Repo-relative paths this unit may edit.

create.description: Repo-relative paths this unit may create.

test.description: Test files this unit creates or modifies.

handoff.description: Files this unit may discover need changes but does not own.

workerTaskId.description: Task ID of the dispatched worker subagent, for session resumption.

branchName.description: Git branch name created for this unit's work.

prUrl.description: URL of the pull request for this unit, if created.

handoffsRequested.description: Handoffs this unit has requested during execution.

skipped.description: Validation rule IDs that were skipped.

knownBaselineFailures.description: Known pre-existing test failures from FAILING_TESTS.md that are unrelated to this unit.

completedAt.description: ISO 8601 datetime when this unit was marked completed.

errorMessage.description: Error message if the unit is in failed or blocked status.

ConflictEntry.description: An entry in the shared file conflict matrix.

file.description: Repo-relative path of the shared file.

units.description: Unit IDs that touch this file.

ownershipRule.description: Description of how ownership is divided among units.

status.description: Current resolution status of this conflict.

command.description: The bash command or manual check description.

exitCode.description: Exit code of the command. 0 = pass, non-zero = fail. null for manual checks.

Blocker.description: A blocker preventing one or more units from proceeding.

blockingUnits.description: Unit IDs that are causing the block.

resolution.description: How to resolve this blocker, or 'human_review' if escalation is needed.

HandoffRequest.description: A handoff requested by a worker when it needs to touch a file outside its write boundary.

file.description: Repo-relative path of the file needing changes.

reason.description: Why the worker needs this file changed.

targetUnit.description: Which unit should handle this handoff.

resolved.description: Whether this handoff has been resolved.
